sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R Case No.2964 of 2022 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhadrak, arising out of Bhadrak Rural P.S. Case No.567 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 341/376/506 IPC.
3.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Bhadrak, by order dated 7.2.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 14.11.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 20.1.2023, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
5.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
7.
Considering the tenor thereof and filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin.
8. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station Goutam Jena vs State Of Odisha ....

. Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin and shall not threaten the victim and/or her family members.
